content.text: {"message":"花びら形の台座の形と寸法を維持し、色を薄紫の#9060c0に変更します。","changes":[{"path":"program.upsert","value":{"id":"model-1","name":"花びら形台座","x":0,"y":0,"color":"#9060c0","size":[90,90,6],"source":"const petals=8;const w=90;const h=6;const r=w/4;const angleStep=Math.PI*2/petals;let points=[];for(let i=0;i<petals;i++){const angle=i*angleStep;const cx=w/2+r*Math.cos(angle+angleStep/2);const cy=w/2+r*Math.sin(angle+angleStep/2);const px=w/2+Math.cos(angle)*r;const py=w/2+Math.sin(angle)*r;points.push([px,py]);points.push([cx,cy]);}let shape=[];for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){shape.push(points[i]);}shape.push(points[0]);return extrude(shape,h);"}}]}
